title: Custom Enchants
summary: **Custom Enchants** are enchantments the SMP adds on top of the vanilla ones: 141 of them, for weapons, armour, tools, hoes, fishing rods and two gear sets.

blocks.p: Most custom enchants are bought at the **Upgrade** bench in `/craft`. Put in a piece of gear, pick an enchant and buy its next level with Prism Shards and money. The bench sells each enchant up to the max level in the tables below. Levels 3 and up also need a Chromabithia level, which you earn in [Heartwood](/wiki/smp/dungeons/).

ul: {{icon:enchanted_book}} Random enchant books (Simple, Unique, Elite, Ultimate and Legendary) come from crates and the Battle Pass. Drag a book onto an item in your inventory to apply it.
A book can fail. A failed book is used up, but the item is never lost.
{{icon:chromatic_chestplate}} Chromatic gear comes with its Prism enchants already on it. Halloween gear has its own, from the retired Halloween Crate. The Upgrade bench does not sell those.
An item starts with 9 custom enchant slots.
Books do not combine. Two books of the same enchant, or a book on an item that already has it, will not raise the level. Levels come from the Upgrade bench and Awakening.

Custom enchants that trigger when you hit, shoot or get hit work only against mobs, apart from Backbone, Hardened and the head enchants (Decapitation, Trophy Hunter and Headhunter). Always-on effects such as Overload and Gears still apply.
**Awakening** in `/craft` destroys one random upgrade on the item and pushes another one or two levels past its cap, up to 10 levels past it. You do not choose which.

{{icon:grindstone}} The **Disenchant** bench in `/craft` takes one enchant of your choice off an item for 200 Prism Shards. The enchant is destroyed and nothing is refunded. Thorns and vanilla curses cannot come off.

blocks.p: These come built into Chromatic gear, from the Chroma Crate or the bench in `/craft`.
These are on Halloween gear, which came from the Halloween Crate. The crate is retired. Pieces players already own keep their enchants.

history.text: Added three enchants: Executioner for swords and axes, and Prospector and Fortune's Favour for swords.
Custom enchants that trigger on a hit now work only against mobs.
37 custom enchants were removed, including True Strike and Grievous Wounds.
The Upgrade bench now sells most custom enchants, and books no longer combine, so levels come only from the bench and Awakening.
Added Grievous Wounds for swords and axes: hits cut your target's healing.
True Strike was reworked: each level makes it likelier that a hit deals an extra half heart through armour.
Thorns is now locked on Chromatic armour, and Fuddle was disabled.
Fabled books were removed from every source, and the Kill Aura and Slingshot enchants were removed.
Added True Strike, a sword enchant on the Upgrade bench that hits through armour.
